targets.summary: Version handling assumes the patch version is always 0 (TORCH_VERSION_{major}_{minor}_0); it needs to support non-zero patch versions.
targets.evidence: Before: `major, minor = required_version` / `required_macro = f"TORCH_VERSION_{major}_{minor}_0"`. Merged: `major, minor, patch = required_version` / `required_macro = f"TORCH_VERSION_{major}_{minor}_{patch}"`. The patch is no longer hardcoded to 0. The version tuple types were also widened to tuple[int, int, int] throughout the file.
